# Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

> > Wikipedia is a free, collaborative online encyclopedia built and maintained by millions of volunteers worldwide, providing open access to human knowledge across all subjects.

Wikipedia is powered by MediaWiki software and the Wikimedia Foundation, offering free content under Creative Commons licensing. The site serves as a comprehensive reference resource with community-driven editing, real-time change tracking, and extensive help resources for both readers and contributors.

## Key Topics

- Wikipedia
- Wikimedia Foundation
- MediaWiki
- Free content
- Creative Commons licensing
- Edit tracking
- Wiki markup
- VisualEditor
- Wikimedia Commons
- Featured articles
- Community collaboration
- Vandalism patrol
- File upload
- Copyright licensing
- English Wikipedia

## Getting Started

- [Main Page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Wikipedia's main homepage featuring featured articles and current topics
- [Wikipedia:About](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): About page explaining Wikipedia's mission, history, and Wikimedia Foundation
- [Wikipedia - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia): Wikipedia article about itself covering history, mission, and Wikimedia Foundation
- [Help:Introduction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Introduction): Tutorial for new editors on wiki markup, VisualEditor, and editing basics
- [Wikipedia:Contents](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contents): Navigation hub and table of contents for browsing Wikipedia by subject

## Help & Documentation

- [Help:Contents](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Contents): Help guide directory covering editing, searching, and contributing basics
- [Wikipedia:File upload wizard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:File_upload_wizard): Guide for uploading media files with copyright and licensing requirements
- [Free content](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free_content): Article on free content, Creative Commons licensing, and open collaboration
- [Wikipedia:Contact us](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contact_us): Contact information and support resources for readers and contributors

## Community & Collaboration

- [Wikipedia:Community portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Community_portal): Hub for community collaboration, projects, and discussion forums
- [Portal:Current events](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Current_events): Portal showcasing breaking news and current world events coverage
- [Talk:Main Page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talk:Main_Page): Discussion page for Main Page edits and community guidelines

## Tools & Maintenance

- [Special:RecentChanges](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:RecentChanges): Real-time tracking of recent edits and vandalism patrol monitoring tool
- [Special pages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:SpecialPages): Directory of special administrative and maintenance pages and tools
- [Special:RecentChangesLinked](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:RecentChangesLinked/Main_Page): Edit tracking tool monitoring changes to linked pages and watchlist
- [Special:WhatLinksHere](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:WhatLinksHere/Main_Page): Backlink analysis tool showing pages linking to Main Page

## Optional

- [Special:Random](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Random): Random article feature linking to encyclopedia content pages
- [Wikipedia homepage (index.php)](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php): Wikipedia homepage redirecting to main encyclopedia interface
